sources.entry: Claude - Your AI partner on desktop. Fast, focused, and designed for deep work.

Claude Cowork *(Anthropic)* — Anthropic's desktop AI agent with a graphical interface. Persistent access to local files and apps, designed as a GUI-friendly complement to Claude Code (which is CLI-first). Launched January 2026. Closed-source / subscription.

summary.name: Claude Desktop
summary.one_liner: Anthropic's desktop app for Claude, offering chat, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork on Mac, Windows, and Linux, with mobile pairing and browser and file-system integrations.
use_cases: Chat with Claude from a desktop app
Hand off coding tasks from phone to desktop
Automate browser forms and navigation with Claude in Chrome
Work with local files and apps via an AI agent
Deploy Claude company-wide with MSIX or PKG installers
Run Claude Code with previews and PR status in a desktop app
summary.what_it_does: The page is the download page for the Claude desktop app, which is available for Mac, Windows, and Linux (Linux in beta for Ubuntu and Debian), and mentions iOS and Android mobile apps. The desktop app includes quick-entry access from anywhere on the system and desktop extensions that connect Claude to local files, browsers, and native applications. Claude Code runs inside the desktop app, where users can preview servers, review local code changes, and monitor pull request status, and a CLI conversation can be moved over with /desktop. Claude Cowork runs tasks on the desktop, with local sessions staying on-device. Web-based connectors such as Google Drive and Slack work across web, desktop, and mobile, and Claude in Chrome can navigate and fill forms in the browser when enabled.
notable: Pairs with mobile app: send tasks from phone to Claude Cowork or Claude Code CLI
Desktop extensions give access to local files, browsers and native apps
Enterprise deployment via MSIX and PKG installers with SSO and extension pre-approval
Claude in Chrome lets Claude click and fill forms in the browser
caveats: Claude Code and Claude Cowork require Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise plans; Chat is available on Free
Linux desktop app is beta, supports only Ubuntu and Debian, and lacks Computer Use and Dictation for now
Quick Entry global hotkey on Linux Wayland requires the GlobalShortcuts portal
